purpose: Reviewer-facing star-level proposal for approval before spectra are downloaded or holdout results are inspected.

identity_crossmatch.proper_motion_propagation: linear propagation to the later catalogue epoch when pmRA/pmDec are available
identity_crossmatch.locking_rule: Resolve every manual_review_required record and re-run alias, catalogue-ID and coordinate checks before holdout_locked.
identity_crossmatch.gaia_note: Gaia DR2 and DR3 identifiers are release-qualified and are not assumed equal across releases.

selection_summary.selection_method: Select 60 ordinary-supported GBS stars within pre-set HR-diagram strata, evenly across published metallicity ordering, after excluding bundled development stars, indirect-diameter/SB2 flags, and conditional model-suitability flags. Place conditional and unsupported diversity cases in a separate 12-star sensitivity/stress set. Numeric reference values were used only for inventory stratification and are not copied into this fitting manifest.

download_footprint.basis: Mean sizes of the 12 bundled GBSv3 R42KNorm files and three bundled XSL DR2 three-arm sets.
download_footprint.checksums: Record SHA-256 after approval and download; none are claimed in this proposal.
